what: Visual-realism prototypes for the URC Autonomy world (gz-sim 8.10, gz-rendering 8.2.2, Ogre-Next 2.3.3 Metal, Apple M4 16 GB). Renders are headless camera-sensor frames via TestFixture; BEFORE = stock sim/worlds/urc_autonomy.sdf (snapshot 2026-10-06 18:10), AFTER = all prototypes combined. Same camera poses in both.

views.chase: driver-station chase pose: 5 m behind rover, pitch 0.3, 960x540 hfov 1.2
views.onboard: rover mast camera pose 0.85 m, 640x480 hfov 1.5
views.aerial: 140 m up, 166 m south of rover, pitch 0.5
views.ground: 1.8 m up looking down 1.0 rad (texture close-up)
views.mesa: 1.6 m eye height facing the Post-1 butte
views.slope_close: 1.2 m on the butte foot slope
views.badlands: 40 m up over the Morrison banded hills (SW)
views.look_W: horizon west (Factory Butte, C2 station box in view)
views.high: bird's-eye 900 m up from 2.5 km south (free-fly map case)

after_config.terrain_visual: Terra heightmap: global albedo = NAIP 2021 0.6 m orthophoto resampled to 4096^2 over 2048 m (0.5 m/texel), shrubs inpainted, saturation x1.25 contrast x1.1 (linear); 3 detail layers: pavement2 3.3 m tile w~0.35 everywhere, silt 7.7 m w~0.15 everywhere, slab 5.1 m from h=62 m (w up to 0.47 at the top); ortho pre-compensated per texel so the result = ortho + zero-mean detail (prototype/terra_mix.py). First texture is passed as detail layer 0 with a flat 16x16 normal map because SDF requires <normal> and an unresolvable/empty one fails to load.
after_config.heightmap_visual: 0.5 m lidar (sim/data/dem/route_area_lidar_0p5m.tif, 4097^2) for the visual only; collision kept at 1 m 3DEP (visual vs collision differ std 5.4 cm, p99 18 cm) - prototype shortcut
after_config.gz_media_patch: GZ_RENDERING_RESOURCE_PATH -> patched copy of share/gz/gz-rendering8 (prototype/gz_media_patch/*.diff): Terra roughness fix, procedural sky shader, distance haze beta 4e-5 /m
after_config.far_field: visual-only GLB mesh 65 x 80 km, 120 m grid (0.72 M tris), 3DEP + NAIP overview 26-33 m/px, Earth curvature, hole under the 2 km heightmap; horizon plane removed
after_config.scatter: shrubs: 9208 NAIP-detected shrubs within 400 m as 6-10 low-poly blobs each (1.48 M tris, cast shadows); pebbles: 20302 within 35 m (0.78 M tris, no shadows); GLB per colour

peak_memory_footprint_MB (/usr/bin/time.mesh_terrain_2m_glb_instead_of_Terra: +~900 (2.1 M tris, no detail layers possible)
peak_memory_footprint_MB (/usr/bin/time.obj_instead_of_glb: OBJ pebbles 709k tris +500 MB; OBJ shrubs 2.6M tris pushed peak to 4.0 GB

measured.files: visbench_final.json, visbench_parts.json, visbench1.json (texture variants, all within noise), bench2.json (with physics: rendering overlaps physics, not usable for cost)

does_not_work_here.scene_fog: <scene><fog> is parsed by sdformat but gz-sim 8 RenderUtil never applies it and gz-rendering 8 ogre2 has no fog API -> implemented as a shader piece instead
does_not_work_here.sky_cubemap_uri: <sky><cubemap_uri> not read by gz-sim 8 (sky is on/off with the stock skybox.dds) -> procedural sky shader replaces skybox_fs
does_not_work_here.projector_decals_with_heightmap: any <projector> in a world with a Terra heightmap aborts the process on Metal: Terra PixelShader fails to compile (decalsDiffuseTex undeclared); reproduced with stock media
does_not_work_here.lens_distortion: camera <distortion> silently ignored with ogre2 (no Ogre2DistortionPass in gz-rendering 8): output identical
does_not_work_here.camera_noise: works but attenuated: requested stddev 0.007/0.02/0.05/0.1/0.2 gave pixel std 0.02/0.23/1.5/6.0/19 DN; the rover's realistic ~2 DN needs stddev ~0.06-0.07, or add noise in the station/bridge
does_not_work_here.motion_blur_exposure_bloom_ssao: no API in gz-rendering 8 ogre2 / SDF

works: NAIP global albedo on Terra (first texture size == terrain size)
ortho + detail layers with per-texel compensation
Terra roughness patch (stock = mirror-like ground, sun glints, sky reflections)
procedural sky + haze via GZ_RENDERING_RESOURCE_PATH media copy
GLB meshes (write them Z-up: gz does not rotate glTF Y-up)
steps: steps/*.jpg: each prototype vs its predecessor, same viewpoints
prototype: prototype/*.py are the throwaway scripts used (paths point at a scratch dir); prototype/textures: procedural detail textures (tileable 2048^2) and previews
